method.sampling: Every exported triangle in every source mesh at all 121 inclusive animation times per clip. No priority surface subsampling.
method.alarm: areaRatio < 0.05; per-mesh severe if count > 3 OR count / eligible > 0.01; unchanged R1/M2 engineering screen, not medical strain bound.
method.coordinates: Metres; canonical GLB POSITION immutable rest coordinates versus actual LBS world-space pose. Exported vertex and triangle indices are not original Blender polygon IDs.
method.sourceEvidence: 467 source identities/base geometry verified by frozen R1 independent-source-preservation proof; no claim of original source raw index correspondence. glTF export splits vertices.
method.limits: No calibrated anatomy attachment, tissue force or collision inference. These are authored diagnostic clips. Full triangle coverage is only for 121 temporal samples.
